SELECT prd_issueplan_code prdIssuePlanCode, prd_issueplan_name prdIssuePlanName, DATE_FORMAT(vdate, '%Y-%m-%d') vdateStr, DATE_FORMAT(edate, '%Y-%m-%d') edateStr, '' AS prdPlanSerisId, '' AS planTargetAmtStr, '' AS planChangeAmtStr, '' AS strategyId, '' as configScaleStr, '' as assetType, '' as assetConfigScaleStr, remark remark, prd_issueplan_code childInfo, 'root' parentInfo, '02' hasChildren FROM prd_issueplan_info where 1=1
AND prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND edate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND vdate = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND edate = STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT '' as prdIssuePlanCode, '' as prdIssuePlanName, '' as vdateStr, '' as edateStr, CONCAT_WS('',ppd.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_NAME , '(', pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID , ')') as prdPlanSerisId, FORMAT(ppd.plan_target_amt) as planTargetAmtStr, FORMAT(ppd.plan_change_amt) as planChangeAmtStr, '' as strategyId, '' as configScaleStr, '' as assetType, '' as assetConfigScaleStr, '' as remark, CONCAT_WS('',pis.PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE,pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID) as childInfo, pis.prd_issueplan_code as parentInfo, '02' hasChildren FROM PRD_ISSUEPLAN_STRATEGY pis left join PRD_PLAN_DETAIL ppd on pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID = ppd.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID
LEFT JOIN PRD_PLAN_INFO ppi ON ppi.PRD_PLAN_CODE = ppd.PRD_PLAN_CODE
left join prd_issueplan_info pip on pip.prd_issueplan_code = pis.prd_issueplan_code where 1=1
AND ppi.VDATE = pip.VDATE AND ppi.EDATE = pip.EDATE
AND pip.prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND edate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND vdate = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND edate = STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT '' as prdIssuePlanCode, '' as prdIssuePlanName, '' as vdateStr, '' as edateStr, '' as prdPlanSerisId, '' as planTargetAmtStr, '' as planChangeAmtStr, pis.STRATEGY_ID as strategyId, FORMAT(pis.COFING_SCALE) as configScaleStr, '' as assetType, '' as assetConfigScaleStr, '' as remark, CONCAT_WS('',pis.PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE,pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID,pis.strategy_id) as childInfo, CONCAT_WS('',pis.PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE,pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID) as parentInfo, '02' hasChildren FROM PRD_ISSUEPLAN_STRATEGY pis left join prd_issueplan_info pip on pip.prd_issueplan_code = pis.prd_issueplan_code where 1=1
AND pip.prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND edate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND vdate = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND edate = STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT '' as prdIssuePlanCode, '' as prdIssuePlanName, '' as vdateStr, '' as edateStr, '' as prdPlanSerisId, '' as planTargetAmtStr, '' as planChangeAmtStr, '' as strategyId, '' as configScaleStr, pis.asset_type as assetType, FORMAT(pis.COFING_SCALE) as assetConfigScaleStr, '' as remark, '' as childInfo, CONCAT_WS('',pis.PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE,pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID,pis.strategy_id) as parentInfo, '01' hasChildren FROM PRD_ISSU_STRATEGY_DETAIL pis left join prd_issueplan_info pip on pip.prd_issueplan_code = pis.prd_issueplan_code where 1=1
AND pip.prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND edate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND vdate = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND edate = STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT prd_issueplan_code prdIssuePlanCode, prd_issueplan_name prdIssuePlanName, DATE_FORMAT(vdate, '%Y-%m-%d') vdateStr, DATE_FORMAT(edate, '%Y-%m-%d') edateStr, '' AS assetType, '' AS planTargetAmtStr, '' AS planChangeAmtStr, remark as remark, CONCAT(IFNULL( prd_issueplan_code,''),'_SSS') childInfo, 'root' parentInfo, '02' hasChildren FROM prd_issueplan_info where 1=1
AND prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND edate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND vdate = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND edate = STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL SELECT '' AS prdIssuePlanCode, '' AS prdIssuePlanName, NULL AS vdateStr, NULL AS edateStr, pia.asset_type AS assetType, FORMAT(pia.plan_target_amt) AS planTargetAmtStr, FORMAT(pia.remain_change_amt) AS planChangeAmtStr, '' as remark, '' AS childInfo, CONCAT(IFNULL(prd_issueplan_code ,'')pia.,'_SSS') AS parentInfo, '01' hasChildren FROM prd_issueplan_asset_datail pia left join prd_issueplan_info pip on pip.prd_issueplan_code = pia.prd_issueplan_code where 1=1
AND pip.prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND edate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND vdate = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND edate = STR_TO_DATE(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT apd.asset_type assetType, apd.plan_target_amt/10000 planTargetAmt, apd.plan_change_amt/10000 planChangeAmt FROM asset_plan_detail apd LEFT JOIN asset_plan_info api ON apd.asset_plan_code = api.asset_plan_code where api.vdate = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and api.edate = STR_TO_DATE(#{edate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
